response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished full-stack/web engineer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang experience, but the role demands deep embedded C development, Linux kernel source-code analysis, L2/L3 networking security expertise, and native-level Japanese — none of which are evidenced in this resume. The C/C++ exposure is limited and dated, and there is no background in network switches, security protocols like MACsec or 802.1X, or firmware development. The mismatch on hard requirements is disqualifying despite overall seniority.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience across web, mobile, and systems
Some low-level and performance-oriented experience (DLang low-latency services, C/C++ at National Instruments, Linux)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, and knowledge sharing
concerns: No native-level Japanese proficiency, a hard requirement for the role
No embedded firmware, Linux kernel modification, or LAN-switch/networking security experience (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP, NETCONF)
C programming experience is minimal and dates back roughly a decade; current focus is web/full-stack

key_factors.factor: No embedded networking / Linux kernel / security domain experience
Strong general engineering seniority and low-level exposure
